permissions: local preservation and bounded research use
public bibliographic metadata and provenance may remain tracked
Wikimedia Commons declares the exact acquired file public domain and not copyrighted
the Commons file page exposes an open HTTPS download route for the exact file revision
restrictions: the operator-held payload remains local and is not a future-site upload
the Commons public-domain statement is source evidence rather than a jurisdiction-complete ToS legal conclusion
the underlying 1892 text, physical copy, UNC scan, Internet Archive derivative lineage, Commons file revision, embedded OCR, and later derivatives remain separately reviewable
any future public-site payload must be independently selected or reacquired through an exact currently authorized route after human rights review
rationale: The exact Commons file carries strong positive evidence: a public-domain declaration, Copyrighted=False, an open exact-file route, visible institutional holding marks, and a historical 1892 edition. Those facts make the public route a serious future publication candidate but do not replace jurisdiction-specific human review or the operator rule that locally held files are never uploaded to the site.
